senses.gloss: (b. h., v. גּוּשׁ) to make the earth cloddy (v. Ges. H. Dict.10 s. v.).—Part. pass. גָּשׁוּם cloddy in consequence of ample rains.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 5:2:5">Y. Yoma V, 42ᶜ</cite> top <he>שנת גְּשׁוּמָה שחונה וכ׳</he> (sub. <cite ref="A03230"><he>ארץ</he></cite>) a year in which the earth forms clods, then is parched so as to form scabs, and then moistened with dew; Bab.

<cite ref="Yoma 53b">ib. 53ᵇ</cite> <he>שנת שחונה שנת ג׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>שנה ג׳ ושח׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note), expl. <he>אם שח׳</he> (<he>היא</he>) <he>תהא ג׳</he> if it is to be parched, let it first be soaked with heavy rains; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 20">Lev. R. s. 20</cite>; Tanḥ. Aḥăré 3 (corr. acc.); ed. Bub. ib. 4.

senses.gloss: (denom. of גֶּשֶׁם) to be frought with rain, rain-bringing.
units: <cite ref="Bava Batra 25b">B. Bath. 25ᵇ</cite> since the destruction of the Temple <he>לא הוּגְשְׁמָה וכ׳</he> the south wind has not been rain-bringing.
